newsitem.title: USA: Kennecott Utah smelter maintenance on track.
newsitem.headline: Kennecott Utah smelter maintenance on track.

text.p: Maintenance at Kennecott Utah Copper Corp's smelter is on track and within the time allocated by the company, a spokesman said.
The smelter shut on April 15 with a plan to complete the maintenance in 42 days before starting up again.
"That timeframe is looking good," a Kennecott spokesman said.
Dealers have said the shutdown at 270,000 tonnes per year Kennecott smelter helped to tighten the U.S. market where demand is good.
